cohort: The study included 920 pregnant women who visited the obstetrics and gynecology clinic of a private hospital in Hatay following a major earthquake.
finding: The study reported various clinical outcomes for pregnant women after a major earthquake, noting high rates of cesarean sections (83.8% of births), and occurrences of preterm births (0.68% of total cohort) and post-traumatic stress disorder (0.76% of total cohort).
mod_finding: Out of 740 recorded births, 120 (16.2%) were normal vaginal deliveries and 620 (83.8%) were cesarean sections.
